markup.jesusWords: Native source wj spans take precedence. Full-verse inheritance follows the pinned KJV1769 wj source. All KJV-mixed native units have edition-specific reviewed, raw-text-hash-pinned speech spans or explicit reviewed omissions; narration is not colored.
markup.translatorAdditions: USFM add spans are preserved as [ADD] markers.
markup.footnotesAndCrossReferences: Source apparatus is excluded from display text.

headings.textSource: Localized editorial headings already shipped with the app; not publisher headings for this alternate edition.
headings.placement: Explicit per-chapter beforeVerse lookup in the alternate edition's displayed coordinates.
headings.emptyChapters: Stored as explicit empty arrays; runtime fallback is forbidden.

sourceMapping.reason: The source module uses merged, shifted, or explicitly empty verse slots; the app preserves the source text while exposing the locale's reference numbers.

sources.mappingSource: Matching named-edition BibleGateway reference markers establish identity rows; reviewed local passage continuity establishes each SPECIAL row. Cached hashes establish modern source structure only, not parity with checked-in wording.

modernStructure.algorithm: SHA-256 over sorted relative UTF-8 JSON paths, a NUL byte, and exact file bytes

sources.coveragePolicy: Every non-residual app-base coordinate has an explicit mapping. Residual source-only and target-only coordinates remain unresolved and fail closed; no a/b subdivisions or inferred adjacent mappings.
